crossRefs.note: Samuel arose, and went from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. Saul counted the people who were present with him, about six…
Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people who were present with them, stayed in Geba of Benjamin; but the Philistines…
He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.
They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled.

people.name: Gibeah
people.line: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.

people.name: Migron
people.line: A place near Gibeah where Saul camped

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul stayed in the uttermost part of Gibeah under the pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people who were with him were about six hundred men;
translations.bsb: Meanwhile, Saul was staying under the pomegranate tree in Migron on the outskirts of Gibeah. And the troops who were with him numbered about six hundred men,
translations.kjv: And Saul tarried in the uttermost part of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people that were with him were about six hundred men;
translations.asv: And Saul abode in the uttermost part of Gibeah under the pomegranate-tree which is in Migron: and the people that were with him were about six hundred men;
